groups.spec: ObjectProxy transparent operations and self state
patch helpers, wrapper chains, and restoration
lazy imports and typed path errors

excluded_upstream_behaviors.mypy: Requires a separately pinned type-checker and compares tool output rather than runtime behavior.
excluded_upstream_behaviors.stress: Probabilistic free-threading programs are not a deterministic fixed denominator.
excluded_upstream_behaviors.native-only: The fixed adapter accepts either the C accelerator or pure-Python fallback.
excluded_upstream_behaviors.platform: Windows and interpreter-specific cases are outside the Linux CPython contract.

coverage_statement: Every fixed leaf maps to a named behavior in instruction.md; no scored leaf imports trusted candidate code or depends on a private helper name.
